implementation.targetScope: Public value lexer, mutable AST, walk, stringify and unit APIs

caller.scope: Installed css-to-react-native 3.2.0 under styled-components 6.1.17. VentiMath uses the web StyleSheetManager iframe demo API; this converter serves the native entry, not browser style rendering.

changes: Independently written iterative parse/traversal/serialization avoids stack exhaustion at deep function nesting.
Malformed source offsets stay within input; overlapping /*/ remains an unclosed comment rather than losing a slash.
Slash-adjacent whitespace is consistently owned by the divider, including after a closed function.
